description: Get The Standard Reserve (TSR)'s hourly ETH flow into and out of the ETH/STANDARD pool on Robinhood Chain, with swap counts and net flow per hour. Filter with hours (how many hours of history to return); the most recent hour may still be open and update as new swaps arrive. Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings. Divide by 1e18 to get token amounts.

hours.description: Hours of history to return (default set by the API)

title: TSR Hourly Flow
